trailhead.label: Behind the Franziskuskirche in Compatsch, the board’s start

cautions: About 2 km on asphalt, mostly the farm and hotel lanes around Compatsch and the Hotel Steger; one crossing of the Seiser Alm road: lead short.
Open pasture with grazing cattle and horses in summer: lead on, and give the herds room.
The Großes Moos wetland beside path 10: keep your dog on the path.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
